*   `?g A14`: The main concept is A14 (Food / Eating / Edible).
    *   `+ H4`: A cube on H4 (Round/Disc/Filled circle) in the same group as `?g`. This means the food is round.
    *   `+ F8`: A cube on F8 (Cut – Break – Separation – Half) in the same group as `?g`. This means the food is often cut or broken.

    *   Main Concept: Food (A14)
    *   Feature 1: Round (H4)
    *   Feature 2: Cut/Broken (F8)

    *   Pizza (Round, cut into slices)
    *   Cake (Round, often cut)
    *   Cookie (Round, can be broken/cut)
    *   Orange (Round, peeled/cut)
    *   Bread (Some types are round, broken/cut)
    *   Pie (Round, cut)

    *   "Pizza" is a very strong candidate for "Round Food" that is "Cut".
    *   "Cake" is another strong one.
    *   "Cookie" is also possible.

    1. Pizza
    2. Cake
    3. Cookie
